snippet.title: Hoshi Saga 5: Ringoame - Walkthrough
snippet.description:
- Note -

I know this Video Walkthrough lags alot! That's because I've lost my fast computer, which means that there won't be many Video walkthroughs from me anymore, well not smooth ones anymore :(

And if a mini-game doesn't load, it's because there are too many people playing the game at once. Try waiting a bit and then reloading the page, and try to play that mini-game again :D

- Info -

Hoshi Saga hits the Web once again, with another Fantastic Hoshi Saga game! Like all the other games, you have to find a Star by doing something. This game is very easy, but still fun! Please take your time to beat this game by yourself, or watch this Terrible Video Walkthrough!

Play The Game: http://hoshisaga.jp/hoshi5/index.html [Heavy Traffic]

Please SUBSCRIBE & ENJOY!

Prid
